profile.visual_desc: Brown-scaled draconic humanoid with large leathery wings and a thick tail. Wears steel plate armor over blue garments with a red waist sash and carries a grey cross shield.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile of a brown dragon head with a sharp snout, visible fangs, and a piercing teal slit eye. Expression is stoic and determined.
profile.weapon_desc: Steel longsword held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Shield held forward, sword pointed back, wings partially folded in a balanced stance.
profile.step2_windup: Character crouches, flares wings wide, and raises the sword vertically above the head to prepare a heavy strike.
profile.step3_impact: Swings sword downward toward the top-left, generating a large, jagged golden-orange energy arc that follows the blade's path.
profile.step4_finish: Holds a low follow-through pose with wings fully extended as the golden energy trail dissipates.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must precisely follow the downward diagonal trajectory of the sword from its peak height toward the top-left floor.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains view consistency and wind-up. VFX alignment is accurate.
